title: Definition storage
description: Retains and retrieves engineering definitions, identities and recorded rationale in a selected model state.
responsibilities: Retain supplied definitions and decision reasoning independently of the originating session.
Resolve identities and retrieve content with explicit state, scope, interpretation, and completeness outcomes.
Enforce the state and identity conditions at the point where a supplied candidate becomes retained content.

Contribute selected-state authoritative definition, relationship, and recorded provenance access to MOD-016's IF-007 inspection contract through the existing IF-001 boundary; no Baseline retention confirmation is implied by a read.
Capture declared immutable engineering input selections with exact membership/content identity for derived views; reject unestablished live-state consistency.
Retain checked relationship write scopes through IF-001 and withhold coherent affected-state reads while partial publication remains unresolved.
Provide immutable baseline bundle custody, isolated exact recovery output and conditional current-model retirement through IF001 as contributions to IF015; preserve catalog and authority ownership.
owned_state: Retained authored definitions, stable identities, and recorded decision reasoning and associations within a selected model state. This is content custody; domain meaning remains with the relevant definition owner.
Sealed immutable baseline content bundles and attributable custody/publication metadata; baseline identity/catalog policy remains MOD005-owned.

includes: Definition access, supported content retention, identity resolution, and retained rationale access.
Read-only capture of selected model inputs through IF-001, without changing authoritative content.
Immutable engineering baseline content custody and state-bound retirement of selected current model material.
excludes: Choosing revisions, interpreting metamodel rules, granting authority, managing baseline history, or judging decision correctness.

design_limits: IF-001 and IF-002 define content access and relationship-change admission. The SR-008 design selects local custody, staged writes, exclusion and durable unresolved-write metadata; exact physical layout remains a realization detail.

Applicable request authority and exact state remain explicit. Parent state-control.md defines baseline custody and retirement contributions under AR071/076; no content operation grants authority or implements whole-model adoption.

The owning README refines IR001 current-knowledge Design and existing AR001–009 contributions. Logical model services and participant-assisted documentary association do not establish installed commands or executed satisfaction.

sources.basis: Analyst-proposed responsibility boundary derived from the existing Function landscape. Assigned Functions remain authoritative for behavior; this record describes target architecture, not observed implementation.
